title.zh: 间隔与植树 · 段数和点数差一
title.en: Intervals & Fences · Gaps and Posts Differ by One

description.zh: 棵数与段数相差 +1、0 或 −1，取决于两端是否种；锯木头、楼梯同理。假设间隔相等且整除总长。
description.en: Trees and gaps differ by +1, 0 or −1 depending on whether the ends are planted; sawing and stairs follow the same count. Assumes equal spacing that divides the length.

reason.zh: 火柴链的火柴数与植树的棵数都要先数“段”再补起头的一个，差一的来源相同。
reason.en: Matchstick totals and tree counts both count the repeated pieces first and then add the starter, so the off-by-one has the same source.

title.en: Why is it always off by one?
